collection.title: Baby Led Weaning Products | Self-Feeding Essentials
collection.body_html:
Baby Led Weaning Products for Self-Feeding

Baby led weaning allows infants to explore solid foods at their own pace, developing motor skills and healthy eating habits from the start. Our collection features products specifically designed to support the BLW approach for babies 6 months and older.

This collection includes silicone suction plates that stay in place during mealtimes, soft-tipped spoons for safe self-feeding practice, full-coverage bibs to contain messes, and appropriately-sized utensils that fit small hands. Each product supports the core principles of baby led weaning: allowing babies to feed themselves, exploring different textures, and joining family meals.

Baby led weaning products are made from food-grade silicone and BPA-free materials that are safe for teething babies. Suction bases prevent plate throwing, divided sections help with portion control and food separation, and ergonomic handles on utensils promote proper grip development.

Whether you're just starting solids at 6 months or continuing the self-feeding journey, these products make mealtimes less stressful for parents and more engaging for babies learning to eat independently.
